step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows two primary workflows connecting to AWS SageMaker. First, real-time requests from external web/mobile applications flow through an arrow at the top into NuDetect, which contains Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. Lambda calls the Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time model inference. Second, an offline model training pipeline streams data from Amazon Redshift into Amazon S3, which triggers AWS Step Functions (noted with SNS event notifications) to orchestrate Amazon SageMaker model training and batch processing jobs.
